$comment: Lock-In copy pools. The app picks a random line from a pool, avoiding the last one shown. Placeholders: {team}, {pub}, {round}, {n}, {seconds}. A line is skipped when a placeholder has no value, and a line with {n} is skipped when n is less than 2. Where each pool is shown: docs/design/copy-review.md. A venue theme can override or extend any pool.
